description: The file utf8.h defines functions, types, and constants related to UTF-8 encoding handling, width calculations, string reencoding, and dealing with BOMs in a Git project context.

methods.name: display_mode_esc_sequence_len
methods.description: Calculates the length of the escape sequence for display mode in a string.

methods.name: utf8_width
methods.description: Calculates the display width of UTF-8 encoded text, updating the start pointer and remainder size.

methods.name: utf8_strnwidth
methods.description: Returns the width of a given UTF-8 string limited to a specified length, skipping ANSI sequences.

methods.name: utf8_strwidth
methods.description: Returns the width of a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: is_utf8
methods.description: Checks if a given text is valid UTF-8.

methods.name: is_encoding_utf8
methods.description: Checks if a given encoding name indicates UTF-8.

methods.name: same_encoding
methods.description: Checks if two encoding names refer to the same encoding.

methods.name: utf8_fprintf
methods.description: Prints formatted UTF-8 text to a FILE stream.

methods.name: skip_utf8_bom
methods.description: Skips the UTF-8 BOM in a string if present.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_text
methods.description: Adds wrapped text with indentation to a strbuf.

methods.name: strbuf_add_wrapped_bytes
methods.description: Adds wrapped byte data to a strbuf.

methods.name: strbuf_utf8_replace
methods.description: Replaces part of a strbuf with UTF-8 data.

methods.name: reencode_string_iconv
methods.description: Reencodes a string using iconv.

methods.name: char * reencode_string_len(const char * a UNUSED,size_t b UNUSED,const char * c UNUSED,const char * d UNUSED,size_t * e)
methods.description: Reencodes a string to a specified encoding, returning the length.

methods.name: char * reencode_string(const char * in,const char * out_encoding,const char * in_encoding)
methods.description: Reencodes a string to a specified encoding assuming null-termination.

methods.name: mbs_chrlen
methods.description: Returns the character length of a multibyte string segment.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgit
methods.description: Checks if a path matches the .git directory case-insensitively, considering HFS case folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitmodules
methods.description: Checks if a path is .gitmodules, considering HFS case folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitignore
methods.description: Checks if a path is .gitignore, considering HFS case folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotgitattributes
methods.description: Checks if a path is .gitattributes, considering HFS case folding.

methods.name: is_hfs_dotmailmap
methods.description: Checks if a path is .mailmap, considering HFS case folding.

methods.name: strbuf_utf8_align
methods.description: Aligns a UTF-8 string within a strbuf according to specified alignment and width.

methods.name: has_prohibited_utf_bom
methods.description: Checks if a BOM is prohibited for the given encoding and data.

methods.name: is_missing_required_utf_bom
methods.description: Checks if a required BOM is missing for given encoding and data.

ctags.name: reencode_string
ctags.signature: (const char * in,const char * out_encoding,const char * in_encoding)

ctags.name: reencode_string_len
ctags.pattern: /^static inline char *reencode_string_len(const char *a UNUSED, size_t b UNUSED,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * a UNUSED,size_t b UNUSED,const char * c UNUSED,const char * d UNUSED,size_t * e)
